T-104 motion energy: mean absolute frame difference per frame (ffmpeg gray, PB 160x90 whole frame; WT 120x160 crop 414x554+0+0 = the girl), a run is a hold where the energy stays under 0.6 (WT crop) / 0.5 (PB) after a move; peak = largest energy of the move
kind: measured = read on frames or energy curves; estimate = docs/references/VISUAL_TARGET.md (Motion and editorial rhythm, 1 s sampling)

reach.note: one-hand entry to a pose or contact: 10 f empty-handed pointing; a reach to a contact needs its slow-in (2-4 f under 0.008 H/f, VISUAL_TARGET) so 12-20 f

anticipation.note: the pose held (or compressed) before a hand action; VISUAL_TARGET 5-10 f, WT chin hold 12 f

settle.note: peak to under 10 % speed; WT 10 f, VISUAL_TARGET 8-18 f

hold.note: readable key-pose dwell after a beat: 15-17 f after a gesture, 32 f for a stare; VISUAL_TARGET 8-18 f

shared_hold.note: an object held by both hands / two characters before it moves on

place.note: a careful lower to a contact

release.note: fingers open and the hand withdraws after a contact

return.note: a body or arm going back to rest after the beat

beat_interval.note: one readable primary beat every 0.75-1.5 s (VISUAL_TARGET overall tempo)

reaction_delay.note: observer notices (eyes) and the hand answers after the glance; gaze leads a hand target by 2-5 f (VISUAL_TARGET), WT eyes on the boat before the reach

short_vs_reference: end hold after her draw 1 f < hold 12
